A team of first movers, born in Lisbon in 2009 to set the pace of an innovation ecosystem that barely existed yet. More than fifteen years later we work from Lisbon, Brussels, Boston and Sao Paulo, and the habit has not changed: we go first, and we take people with us. Where the work happens “It is the first time that we are doing this, but it is not the first time that we are doing things for the first time .” Our CEO, more often than he probably realises It is the closest thing we have to a job description. Nobody calls us because the path is known. They call us because it is not, and because somebody has to go first and bring the others along. Fifteen years of first times have taught us something that cannot be read in a method: how to move when the map runs out, how to keep several organisations moving together while it happens, and how to tell the difference between a risk worth taking and a detour.
